newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SWIMMING-AVDIYENKO NAMED RUSSIAN SENIOR COACH.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-AVDIYENKO NAMED RUSSIAN SENIOR COACH.

text.p: Viktor Avdiyenko, who coached human 'submarine' Denis Pankratov to two Olympic butterfly titles in Atlanta, has been appointed senior trainer of the Russian swimming team.
Avdiyenko, who also guided Yevgeny Sadovy to three Olympic crowns in Barcelona four years ago, has said he worked out Pankratov's technique of swimming under water for up to 30 metres.
